name: Repco Home Finance Ltd

technical_read: MarketsMojo notes 'valuation shifts' amid a broader market rally - a stock being repriced along with sector sentiment rather than showing an independent breakout.
sentiment_summary: Not deeply covered in the source sheet beyond the summit presentation mention.
bse_notes: No red flag surfaced in available search results.
bull_case: Improving ROE trend over the last 2 years
3 consecutive years of rising net profit
Genuine smallcap size with theoretical headroom
bear_case: Weak historical 5-year sales growth (5.43%) - not a demonstrated high-growth story
NBFC-HFC sector is capital-constrained and competitive (larger, better-funded peers)
No specific catalyst identified beyond general improving trends
market_cap_tier: Smallcap (~Rs 2,301-2,559 Cr) - genuine size headroom, but weak historical growth tempers conviction.
verdict_headline: Slow, steady improvement rather than a high-growth setup - lower conviction
